notes.title: Eye to Eye, Word for Word: Faces Now Speak!
notes.content: [p]In [i]Holey[/i], survival is a team effort. And sometimes, it’s the quiet moments — a glance, a nod, a shared silence — that say the most. With this update, your character’s expressions finally reflect the tension, trust, and terror of your journey.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="to_r_SiZ1QY;full"][/previewyoutube]
